scope: R-006 candidate A: no display MMIO and no wait; stop before CoreDispatcher to separate reset-exit failure from a display MMIO hang
reason: D-124 excluded post-recovery device state and step20 code content. The same step20/query1 predicate succeeded three times and timed out once today, so the timeout must be a hang, not a predicate refusal. Two exits remain indistinguishable on the current 1-bit channel: EnumaStageCheckpoint's ResetCold() failing, or SimpleFbDxe hanging on 0x0ae00000..0x0ae84207.

profiles.stage_semantics: EnumaStageCheckpoint(10) sits immediately before CoreDispatcher() in DxeMain.c, so no DXE driver has been dispatched and no display MMIO address has been read

hardware_order: Verify immediate enuma identity, Android complete, root, slot, unlock, matching backups and original partition digests; then temporary boot once per trial, at most five trials, each preceded by the same verification
stop_conditions: No observable return: stop all additional boots immediately, recover, and record the actual recovery endpoint
Identity, backup, source or digest mismatch: do not boot
A return time alone is not evidence about the display path

discrimination.all_five_return: the reset exit is stable when no display MMIO has been touched; the timeout then belongs to the later dispatch or display path and the next step is MDP power/clock gating versus the R-004 mapping
discrimination.any_trial_stalls: the reset exit fails even with no display MMIO and no wait, so the exit path itself is implicated regardless of image content
discrimination.inconclusive: fewer than five completed trials, or a mismatch between the required identity and digest checks

build_constraints: stage other than 13 forbids --detail-point other than 13, --dispatch-guid, --dispatch-guid-only, --dispatch-completion-fallback and --diagnostic-gop-query; SimpleFbDxe is still packaged but never dispatched because the stop point precedes CoreDispatcher
